title: A Turn off can replace an opt-in another device turned on while its cancel was out
evidence: standalone/reminders.ts:388-397 cancelReminders reads the opt-in, awaits postCancel, then writes { ...optIn, status: 'cancelled' } without reading it again. If another device turns reminders on with a new token meanwhile, the write replaces that active opt-in with the old token cancelled, and the new server row is left with no token in the file. Fix: a sameOptIn re-check after the await, as at :300. Found during PR 1664
